Canada.label: Canada
Canada.headline: TSX climbs 0.11% as metals and energy gains offset oil weakness and tech selloff
Canada.why: No single verified causal driver for the final move was established in the collected sources; the items below are context rather than proven causes.

drivers.label: Metals gains
drivers.detail: Gains in metals stocks offset oil weakness, pushing TSX futures higher (Reuters).

drivers.label: Energy gains
drivers.detail: Energy sector advances lifted the index, offsetting a tech selloff (TradingView; ad‑hoc‑news.de).

drivers.label: Denison leadership
drivers.detail: Denison Mines shares led the market higher, contributing to the composite gain (ad‑hoc‑news.de).

drivers.label: Rate outlook concerns
drivers.detail: Investors weighed rate outlook and commodity swings earlier in the day, which had weighed on the TSX before the final rise (Investing.com Canada).
